**[[Islamist insurgency in Niger]]
***[[Diori Hamani International Airport attack]]

***[[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] insurgents ambush a [[Tank truck|fuel tanker]] convoy in western [[Mali]] near the [[Mali–Senegal border|Senegalese border]], killing at least 15 people, and destroying the tankers amid an [[Mali fuel blockade|ongoing fuel blockade]] by the jihadist group aimed at crippling the [[Economy of Mali|economy]].
